title: The April :: Live Edge Walnut Dining Table
before:
ALL ORDERS SHIP FREE! You can learn more about the Shipping Process Free Shipping.

The Story ::
Design wise this piece started with the idea of the leg system, but as the build progressed I had felt the need to modernize the piece and break up the "wood on wood on wood" feel by adding solid copper leg plate and matching copper screws, which were impossible to find. In the final hour of the build, I decided to further push the design envelope by adding custom CNC milled butterfly "suture" inlays in the checked areas of the slab to stabilize them and echo some of the copper details on other areas of the piece.
Design time totaled 3.5 months between our other projects and "normal" orders, in which I made pattern templates, and distilled the final design so it could be replicated and available for our customers.


Original Design by :: Robert LaRow


The Details:

Dimensions of Photographed piece:104"L x 36-41"W X 29:H

Live Edge Claro Walnut Slab, sourced from northern California, with stunning deep chocolate browns and some reddish/purplish tones. Smaller holes and inclusions were stabilized with dark tinted epoxy.

Leg system is crafted from 8/4" solid walnut with a sculpted mid century modern inspired leg system and plugged with solid copper rod.

Hand rubbed oil finish, finished with matte topcoat. Copper has been buffed to a mirror polish.

Lead Time :: (depends on current project load) approximately 12–16 weeks for production.

Unveiling The Prima: A Captivating Symphony of Craftsmanship and Natural Beauty

Step into a world where artistry and nature intertwine, and let The Prima enchant you with its mesmerizing presence. This extraordinary dining table is the result of meticulous craftsmanship, boasting a live edge walnut slab that tells a story of timeless beauty. With its carefully designed base, custom brass accents, and hand-finished details, The Prima transcends ordinary furniture, becoming a work of art that elevates your dining experience to new heights.

Dimensions + Details:

  • Live Edge Walnut Slab: The Prima proudly features a solid 1 & 3/4" thick Claro Walnut slab that showcases the magnificent beauty of nature. The live edge design preserves the organic contours of the wood, capturing its raw essence and celebrating its unique character.

  • Nakishima Inspired Base: The Prima's base draws inspiration from the revered Nakishima design philosophy. Crafted from solid walnut, it stands as a testament to precision and artistry. The base incorporates bridal joinery for exceptional stability and showcases subtle yet distinctive details, including the reverse cove edge profile on the leg system and roundover edge radius on all structural members.

  • Custom Brass Accents: Adding a touch of elegance and individuality, The Prima is adorned with custom-made solid Brass boomerang keys. These carefully placed brass inlays add a captivating visual element that complements the natural beauty of the walnut slab. Further enhancing the design, solid brass plugs are seamlessly integrated into the leg system, creating a harmonious interplay of materials.

  • Measuring 108"L x 33"/35"W x 30"H, The Prima provides ample space for gathering loved ones and creating cherished memories. Whether it's a lavish feast or an intimate dinner, this dining table sets the stage for moments of connection and celebration. With its harmonious blend of natural beauty, exceptional craftsmanship, and thoughtful design, The Prima becomes the centerpiece that sets your dining area apart.

Crafted with Passion.

Creating The Prima was a labor of love that unfolded during the magical hours of 5:30 to 8:30 am. Being a morning person, I reveled in the uninterrupted serenity of this time, allowing my creativity to flow freely. With minimal interruptions, I immersed myself in the project, infusing it with joy and passion. The result is a dining table that reflects the essence of this creative journey—a masterpiece that embodies the spirit of craftsmanship and artistry.

The Finishing Touch:

To enhance the natural luster and reveal the full potential of the Claro Walnut, The Prima is finished with a hand-applied and buffed, Low VOC, 2 part Oil finish. This specialized finish not only protects the wood but also accentuates its captivating grain patterns and rich hues. With each touch, you'll feel the smoothness and warmth of the surface, inviting you to gather around and indulge in unforgettable dining experiences.

Embrace The Prima:

Unveil the captivating symphony of craftsmanship and natural beauty that is The Prima. Let it become the focal point of your home, igniting conversations and evoking a sense of wonder. As you gather around this extraordinary dining table, immerse yourself in its artistry and let it transform mealtime into an experience that nourishes both body and soul.
